opening.argument: The video walks through PayZapp registration and account setup, with the speaker explaining how to obtain a virtual Visa card while the corresponding app screens are shown. The PAN request and existing card details appear within that setup process; the Rs. 10.00 load is shown as a step toward getting the card. The subsequent PhonePe recharge is framed as a test of the virtual card, not as a promised return. Although the speaker discusses international use, that claim is qualified as untested. Taken together, the on-screen steps and spoken instructions support a technology tutorial and operational demonstration; they do not independently establish deception or any resulting loss.
